claims.text: The driver's own trace fixes his continuous in-geofence dwell at 144 seconds — 15 qualifying fixes running from 13:31:56 to 13:34:20 — against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip, a shortfall of 36 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee non-chargeable and refundable in full where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the free waiting period in force, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages.

POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: the fee is chargeable only if all four limbs hold, and the rider wins by breaking any single one. Limbs (a) and (b) are satisfied here — trip_record carries a driver arrived event at 13:31:56 and the trace holds 15 qualifying fixes inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius — but limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least platform_policy.free_wait_sec, and the trace measures that dwell at 144 seconds. Limb (c) fails, so the fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause.

The waiting clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver tapping 'arrived': 180 seconds from 13:31:56 elapses at 13:34:56, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 13:34:24 — 32 seconds early. Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 requires a termination at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, so that limb fails as well as limb (c).

There is no route on this record to a longer dwell. The trace shows a single in-geofence interval — run_count 1, no excursions — so POL-NS-06(i) has no second interval to add to the first, and limb (i) independently requires a present and populated traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. No advisory covers Northpoint City in this window: EV-ADVIS-02707-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, and I cite that absence as the clause permits — a MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable and can only be asserted, never relied on, as POL-GEN-02 provides.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 displaces it here, and POL-NS-06 states expressly that where the cumulative dwell falls short of the minimum no driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 has nothing to pay on a shortfall.

The bundle is unimpaired and this case is decidable on the papers: the trace carries 100% coverage, 52 fixes at a 10 second cadence, no gaps (max_gap_sec 0.0) and both tracks present; the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count; and the fare line of SGD 4.50 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so limbs (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 are not engaged. No limb of POL-NS-09 is met either: the rider and driver have 0 disputes with each other in 90 days, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, short of the 3 that POL-NS-09(d) requires. The deciding fact therefore carries weight 1.0 and the case should produce a monetary ruling rather than a hold.

The driver's statement that the rider 'was not visible' is contradicted by his own record. The rider's track carries 45 qualifying fixes, every one of them within 19 m of the pickup pin, across 13:29:17 to 13:35:58, and at 13:32:56 the rider messaged 'im at the lobby, coming out', which the driver answered 'ok' at 13:33:11 before cancelling 73 seconds later. The refund does not depend on the rider's presence under POL-NS-06, but the absent-rider account on which the charge rests has no support in the telemetry.

The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line and nothing else: fare_breakdown shows SGD 4.50 charged at 13:34:41 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On a POL-NS-06 shortfall the whole contested SGD 4.50 is refunded to the rider, which is the FULL_REFUND outcome POL-GEN-03 defines for a filing party who is entirely right.

claims.text: Limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the trip record: TRP-02707 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-08-15T13:31:56+08:00, five minutes after acceptance at 13:26:38, and the trip was terminated by the driver and not by the rider.

The arrival is corroborated by the driver's own telemetry rather than merely asserted by a button press: the trace has 100.0% coverage, no gaps at a 10-second cadence, and its first qualifying in-geofence fix is timestamped 2026-08-15T13:31:56+08:00 - the same second as the 'arrived' event - with all 15 qualifying fixes inside the 120 m arrival radius that applies to a LARGE_VENUE pickup under POL-NS-02. The arrival marker is therefore not false and POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the waiting clock properly runs from 13:31:56, and no false-arrival referral against this driver is warranted.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on its own terms: the record shows no boarding event, a termination by the driver at 13:34:24, and cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes that limb (d) recognises. The driver did not enter DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, the one code that is his own admission he could not find the rider, so the code recorded is an accurate description of what he observed and is not a mis-selected reason code.

The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04 and must have the fee decided under POL-NS-01. Limb (a) is met by her message 'im at the lobby, coming out' at 13:32:56 and limb (c) by her own track, whose 45 qualifying fixes remain inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius for the whole window (max_distance_m 18.39) - but limb (b) fails: the driver replied 'ok' at 13:33:11, fifteen seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so the unanswered-contact route is closed on the record.

Nothing in this record supports withholding the driver's compensation or escalating the case away from a monetary ruling. On driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d of 0 against completed_trips_30d of 54, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test (four or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08) is nowhere near tripping; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles, so neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) is engaged. Every artifact in the bundle is admissible at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02 confidence cap is 1.0 and no POL-NS-08(a) clock skew is present either - the arrival event and the first in-geofence fix agree to the second.

The driver's monetary exposure is bounded by the ledger and cannot exceed the fee line. EV-FARE-02707 shows one cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50, a total charged of SGD 4.50, a zero waiting-time line, a zero base fare and no booking or platform fee, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0. The amount in issue on this trip is the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee and nothing else; the rider's gross figure of SGD 6.61 is not a sum charged here and cannot be the subject of any refund.

The driver does not dispute the arithmetic that defeats limb (c), and puts it on the record himself: the derived arrival facts show a single continuous in-geofence run of 144 seconds (15 qualifying fixes, 13:31:56 to 13:34:20) against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, a shortfall of 36 seconds, with the trip terminated at 13:34:24. Limb (c) therefore fails on the record as it stands and the fee cannot be upheld under POL-NS-01. The driver does not stretch the point: POL-NS-06(i) is unreachable here, because the trace shows only one in-geofence interval to accumulate and the traffic advisory covering this pickup is MISSING at weight 0.0, so there is neither a second interval to sum nor an advisory capable of licensing the sum.

The rider's account that the driver 'cancelled after barely two minutes' is not what the record shows, and the driver's conduct should be weighed as it actually was: accepted at 13:26:38, arrived at 13:31:56, a measured in-geofence wait of 144 seconds, terminated at 13:34:24 - seven minutes forty-six seconds after acceptance. The rider said at 13:32:56 that she was still in the lobby and 'coming out', and she had not appeared 88 seconds later when the driver terminated, which is precisely the observation the recorded reason code describes. The driver's shortfall is a timing shortfall on the waiting clock, not a false marker, a fee farm or a failure to look for the rider, and no conduct referral should attach to him.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02707 is refunded in full to the rider.

Why the charge does not stand. The fee rests on POL-NS-01, which is conjunctive — all four of its limbs must hold. Limbs (a) and (b) do hold: EV-TRIP-02707 records a driver 'arrived' event at 13:31:56, and EV-GPS-02707 places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from that same second, on 15 qualifying in-geofence fixes with 100% coverage and no gaps. The arrival marker is therefore genuine and POL-NS-05 (false arrival) is not engaged, so no false-arrival referral attaches to the driver.

Limb (c) fails, and that is decisive. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (EV-TRIP-02707.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The driver's own trace measures his continuous in-geofence dwell at 144 seconds, running from 13:31:56 to 13:34:20 — a shortfall of 36 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full where the effective dwell is shorter than the free waiting period, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to messages. Limb (d) fails as well: 180 seconds from 13:31:56 elapses at 13:34:56, and the driver terminated at 13:34:24, 32 seconds early. POL-NS-06(i) cannot lengthen the dwell — the trace shows a single in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to sum — and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02707-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so nothing permits accumulation.

What is returned. The sum is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 (EV-FARE-02707: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The gross figure of SGD 6.61 was never charged on this trip and is not refunded. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-06 states expressly that none is payable where the dwell falls short, and POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it.

The parties' arguments. The driver's claim that limb (d) is satisfied by the RIDER_NO_SHOW code is rejected in part: the code is one of the three limb (d) recognises, but limb (d) also requires the termination to fall at or after the required dwell elapsed, which it did not. The driver's point that nothing supports withholding compensation or escalating is accepted so far as the anti-farming test goes — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against 54 completed trips in 30 days, so the POL-NS-07 check does not trip, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged — but it does not help him keep the fee, because POL-NS-06 independently refunds it. The rider is not exonerated under POL-NS-04, as the driver correctly says: the driver replied 'ok' at 13:33:11, 15 seconds after her 13:32:56 message, and no in-app call is recorded, so limb (b) closes that route. That does not matter, because the refund follows from the dwell shortfall, not from the contact route. The driver's attack on the rider's account of the timing is not made out: a 144-second wait is two minutes and twenty-four seconds, which is essentially the 'barely two minutes' she described. The rider's account that the driver said she was 'not visible' is contradicted by his own record — EV-GPS-02707's rider track holds 45 qualifying fixes within about 19 m of the pickup pin throughout, and her lobby message was read — but this goes to credibility only, since POL-NS-06 refunds the fee regardless of presence.

Confidence. The deciding fact — the 144-second dwell — is carried by EV-GPS-02707, which is admissible with no issues at weight 1.0. No artifact carrying that fact is impaired, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; confidence is set at 0.95. The only zero-weight artifact, EV-ADVIS-02707-01, carries no fact in this ruling.

The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so under POL-GEN-05 this provisional ruling executes automatically, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

The bundle is unimpaired and this case is decidable on the papers: the trace carries 100% coverage, 52 fixes at a 10 second cadence, no gaps (max_gap_sec 0.0) and both tracks present; the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count; and the fare line of SGD 4.50 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so limbs (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 are not engaged. No limb of POL-NS-09 is met either: the rider and driver have 0 disputes with each other in 90 days, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, short of the 3 that POL-NS-09(d) requires. The deciding fact therefore carries weight 1.0 and the case should produce a monetary ruling rather than a hold.

The driver's statement that the rider 'was not visible' is contradicted by his own record. The rider's track carries 45 qualifying fixes, every one of them within 19 m of the pickup pin, across 13:29:17 to 13:35:58, and at 13:32:56 the rider messaged 'im at the lobby, coming out', which the driver answered 'ok' at 13:33:11 before cancelling 73 seconds later. The refund does not depend on the rider's presence under POL-NS-06, but the absent-rider account on which the charge rests has no support in the telemetry.

The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line and nothing else: fare_breakdown shows SGD 4.50 charged at 13:34:41 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On a POL-NS-06 shortfall the whole contested SGD 4.50 is refunded to the rider, which is the FULL_REFUND outcome POL-GEN-03 defines for a filing party who is entirely right.

Limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the trip record: TRP-02707 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-08-15T13:31:56+08:00, five minutes after acceptance at 13:26:38, and the trip was terminated by the driver and not by the rider.

The arrival is corroborated by the driver's own telemetry rather than merely asserted by a button press: the trace has 100.0% coverage, no gaps at a 10-second cadence, and its first qualifying in-geofence fix is timestamped 2026-08-15T13:31:56+08:00 - the same second as the 'arrived' event - with all 15 qualifying fixes inside the 120 m arrival radius that applies to a LARGE_VENUE pickup under POL-NS-02. The arrival marker is therefore not false and POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the waiting clock properly runs from 13:31:56, and no false-arrival referral against this driver is warranted.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on its own terms: the record shows no boarding event, a termination by the driver at 13:34:24, and cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes that limb (d) recognises. The driver did not enter DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, the one code that is his own admission he could not find the rider, so the code recorded is an accurate description of what he observed and is not a mis-selected reason code.

The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04 and must have the fee decided under POL-NS-01. Limb (a) is met by her message 'im at the lobby, coming out' at 13:32:56 and limb (c) by her own track, whose 45 qualifying fixes remain inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius for the whole window (max_distance_m 18.39) - but limb (b) fails: the driver replied 'ok' at 13:33:11, fifteen seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so the unanswered-contact route is closed on the record.

Nothing in this record supports withholding the driver's compensation or escalating the case away from a monetary ruling. On driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d of 0 against completed_trips_30d of 54, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test (four or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08) is nowhere near tripping; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles, so neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) is engaged. Every artifact in the bundle is admissible at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02 confidence cap is 1.0 and no POL-NS-08(a) clock skew is present either - the arrival event and the first in-geofence fix agree to the second.

The driver's monetary exposure is bounded by the ledger and cannot exceed the fee line. EV-FARE-02707 shows one cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50, a total charged of SGD 4.50, a zero waiting-time line, a zero base fare and no booking or platform fee, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0. The amount in issue on this trip is the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee and nothing else; the rider's gross figure of SGD 6.61 is not a sum charged here and cannot be the subject of any refund.

The driver does not dispute the arithmetic that defeats limb (c), and puts it on the record himself: the derived arrival facts show a single continuous in-geofence run of 144 seconds (15 qualifying fixes, 13:31:56 to 13:34:20) against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, a shortfall of 36 seconds, with the trip terminated at 13:34:24. Limb (c) therefore fails on the record as it stands and the fee cannot be upheld under POL-NS-01. The driver does not stretch the point: POL-NS-06(i) is unreachable here, because the trace shows only one in-geofence interval to accumulate and the traffic advisory covering this pickup is MISSING at weight 0.0, so there is neither a second interval to sum nor an advisory capable of licensing the sum.

ledger.claim: The rider's account that the driver 'cancelled after barely two minutes' is not what the record shows, and the driver's conduct should be weighed as it actually was: accepted at 13:26:38, arrived at 13:31:56, a measured in-geofence wait of 144 seconds, terminated at 13:34:24 - seven minutes forty-six seconds after acceptance. The rider said at 13:32:56 that she was still in the lobby and 'coming out', and she had not appeared 88 seconds later when the driver terminated, which is precisely the observation the recorded reason code describes. The driver's shortfall is a timing shortfall on the waiting clock, not a false marker, a fee farm or a failure to look for the rider, and no conduct referral should attach to him.
